stem: Based on the excerpt and your knowledge of U.S. history, what was the MAIN purpose of this film?

options.label: B
options.text: To promote the cultures of immigrants

options.label: D
options.text: To inspire the creativity of immigrants

visual_elements: An Italian immigrant arrives in America unable to speak English. Following disappointments and misfortunes, he takes language classes and ascends the ladder of success. Created as an education tool directed at industrial workers, this short drama was intended to help . . . immigrants. — "The Making of an American," Library of Congress
